what_this_is: The legacy /careers/score cluster label -> CareerFit family id projection. FM-CF-013 needs it because the two engines do not score the same unit: legacy ranks ~370 individual PROGRAMS, each tagged with a cluster; the .NET engine ranks 14 career FAMILIES. Without a projection there is no common ordering to correlate, so this file is the comparison's premise, not a detail of it.
why_it_is_incomplete: The legacy cluster vocabulary is not in this repository. The catalogue, its clusters and GET /api/v1/careers/clusters all live in formmaps-platform (Node); the FormMaps repo contains exactly ONE legacy cluster string anywhere, the illustrative value in apps/web/src/types/tims.ts:35. Authoring the other entries here would be inventing a taxonomy nobody has seen, and every rank correlation computed through an invented projection would be a measurement of the invention. So this ships with the one evidenced entry and a status that makes the comparator fail closed.
how_to_complete_it: 1. GET /api/v1/careers/clusters against a legacy environment (or SELECT DISTINCT cluster over the career catalogue) to obtain the real vocabulary.

2. For each cluster, assign the CareerFit family id it belongs to, or null where it genuinely belongs to none (a cluster with no family is NOT a defect; family 15 'Ruta Alternativa / No universitaria' is not scorable and legacy has clusters V1 CareerFit does not model).

3. Bump projection_version, set status to REVIEWED_BY_TIMS once TIMS has signed off on the assignment, and re-run the shadow job. Rows carry projectionVersion, so a re-measurement under a corrected projection is a NEW row that can be told apart from the old one, never an overwrite.

4. TIMS review matters here: which legacy cluster maps to which family is a judgement about careers, and getting it wrong turns a correct port into an apparent disagreement (cause TAXONOMY_UNMAPPED / TAXONOMY_NO_LEGACY_EVIDENCE in the report).
minimum_families_note: A pair is comparable only when the projection lands legacy evidence on at least this many families. Three is the floor at which a top-3 overlap means anything at all; below it the metric is arithmetic on nothing. It is deliberately not 14: real legacy answers will not reach every family, and requiring them to would discard the cohort.

Social_and_Behavioral_Sciences.evidence: apps/web/src/types/tims.ts:35 — the only legacy cluster string that appears anywhere in this repository, given there as the documented example value of ScoredCareer.cluster. Assigned to family 13 on the name alone; NOT reviewed by TIMS.

family_names_note: Copied from careerfit-rules.v1.0.0-draft.1.json for the report's readability only. CareerFitShadowProjection asserts they still agree with the loaded rule set, so a rules bump that renamed a family cannot leave a stale name in a report.
